# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target feels pain, and he takes 20% of his remaining hits.
@@ 2
Target has one of his physical stats (characteristics) temporarily lowered by
d10. Only the temporary stat is lowered. Physical stats include Strength,
Agility, Quickness, Constitution, Presence, and Self Discipline (one is
selected at random). When the duration expires, the stat will go back up by
the same amount that it went down (with a maximum of whatever the potential
for the stat is).
@@ 3
As Pain, except the ache seems natural and reduces target’s hits by 10% until
cured (caster must specify nature of ache). The target is unaware that the
spell has been cast on him, because it affects him gradually (target loses 1
hit per minute). The GM should describe the ache as a natural thing (and may
choose not inform the player that the character has reduced hits).
@@ 4
As Pain, except target takes 40% of his remaining hits.
@@ 5
As Impair I, except affects temporary and potential stats.
@@ 6
As Impair I, except decrease is 3d10.
@@ 7
As Ache, except target’s hits are reduced by 20%.
@@ 9
As Pain, except target takes 60% of his remaining hits.
@@ 10
As Trait Erosion I, except decrease is 2d10.
@@ 11
As Impair I, except decrease is 5d10.
@@ 12
As Ache, except target’s hits are reduced by 40%.
@@ 13
As Pain, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
@@ 14
As Pain, except target takes 90% of his remaining hits.
@@ 15
As Trait Erosion I, except decrease is 3d10.
@@ 16
As Impair I, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster’s level.
@@ 18
As Fire Nerves, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster’s
level.
@@ 19
As Trait Erosion I, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster’s
level.
@@ 20
As Impair I, except decrease is 10d10.
@@ 25
As Agony, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
@@ 30
As Trait Erosion I, except decrease is 5d10.
@@ 50
As Trait Erosion I, except one physical stat is reduced to 1.
